title: Tips Compats
description: Adds modded tips for the Tips mod.
body:
## This resourcepack adds mod compatibility to the [Tips](https://modrinth.com/mod/tips) mod!
### Compatibility List: - [Armorable Skeleton Horses](https://modrinth.com/mod/armorable-skeleton-horses) - [Balanced Horse Armor Recipes](https://modrinth.com/mod/bhar) *(Won't work with the datapack version)* - [Horseman](https://modrinth.com/mod/horseman) - [Two Players One Horse](https://modrinth.com/mod/two-players-one-horse) - [Floating Horses](https://modrinth.com/mod/floating-horses) - [Calm down, dog!](https://modrinth.com/mod/calm-down-dog) - [RightClickHarvest](https://modrinth.com/mod/rightclickharvest) - [Deeper and Darker](https://modrinth.com/mod/deeperdarker) - [Tameable Foxes](https://modrinth.com/mod/tameable-foxes) - [Supplementaries](https://modrinth.com/mod/supplementaries) - [Naturalist](https://modrinth.com/mod/naturalist) - [Elytra Trims](https://modrinth.com/mod/elytra-trims) - [Useful Lanterns](https://modrinth.com/mod/useful-lanterns) - [Mobs Attempt Parkour](https://modrinth.com/mod/mobs-attempt-parkour) - [Guarding](https://modrinth.com/mod/guarding) - [Guard Villagers (Fabric/Quilt)](https://modrinth.com/mod/guard-villagers-(fabricquilt)) - [Torch hit!](https://modrinth.com/mod/torch-hit) - [RME's Campfire Leather](https://modrinth.com/mod/rmes-campfire-leather) *(Won't work with the datapack version)* - [Simple Concrete](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-concrete) - [Cycle Paintings](https://modrinth.com/mod/cycle-paintings) - [Reconnectible Chains](https://modrinth.com/mod/reconnectible-chains) - [Sit](https://modrinth.com/mod/bl4cks-sit)
